messages:
Mia Patel: quick sync — we need final alignment on marketplace launch ops + SI handoff. press embargo, partner assets, and who owns the landing page cutover?

Ashish Rao: I can own partner coordination. working list of owners below. will need marketing + legal signoff by EOD Thu.

Clare Nguyen: landing page is about 85% — hero copy, CTA, and form wired. waiting on final logos and SI quotes. link to draft: https://go/redwood/marketing/marketplace-landing (please leave comments) :eyes:

Samir Ortiz: legal here — embargo window confirmed: embargo until 2026-04-02 17:00 PT. no partner-level quotes live before that. Julia pls confirm distribution channels.

Julia Park: distribution: tech press + partner channels. draft press list: TechCrunch, The Register, VentureBeat, and two partner newsletters. I'll prepare embargo list once I have final headline and spokes.

Lina Gomez: product callout to include: Dedicated capacity + Private VPC add-on + initial SI integrations (SignalOps, CloudSI). Please use the exact feature names in the assets doc so we don't drift.

Evan Cho (CloudSI): got it — we'll provide a 2-3 sentence partner blurb and a short customer quote from our pilot by Monday. tagging our PM: @Amir from CloudSI.

Ashish Rao: owners checklist (rough):
- partner blurbs: Evan (CloudSI), Samir to confirm legal signoffs
- press headline & embargo: Julia
- landing page publish + staging cutover: Clare + EngOps
- SI integration docs (marketplace listing how-to): Lina + Evan
- partner co-announcement playbook: Ashish

Mia Patel: timeline reminder: internal dry-run Wed 9am PT, press finalize Thu, publish Mon 17:00 PT (after embargo lifts). If any org needs more runway call it out now.

Clare Nguyen: staging cutover plan -> EngOps will promote staging->prod at 16:00 PT on publish day, quick smoke tests for forms and marketplace listing. sample command for deploy bot:
```
/eng-deploy promote marketplace-landing staging->prod --window=10m
```

OpsBot: deploy window scheduled: 2026-04-06T16:00:00-07:00 (staging->prod). Reminder will post 1h before. :robot_face:

Samir Ortiz: small legal note — partner logos must have brand approval files attached and rights for joint announcement. please upload to the assets folder (we need png + svg).

Evan Cho (CloudSI): will upload logos + quote today. also confirm we'll run a joint webinar 1 week after launch, need registration CTA on landing.

Julia Park: headline suggestion (placeholder): "Redwood Inference launches unified marketplace with partner integrations for predictable LLM inference." open to edits. I can run a shortened A/B for subject lines with comms team.

Ashish Rao: one operational edge case — if a partner misses asset delivery by Fri EOD, fallback: list placeholder with "partner coming soon" and remove quote. want to avoid blocking publish.

Mia Patel: agreed. risk register item noted. final asks: people add a single comment in the doc with approval by Thu noon. i'll run the dry-run agenda and send calendar invite now. :calendar:
